searchText: Right now I use Go and Rust as reference implementations and Go already had this tricks even before, so Rust was setting a limit. If someone uses MCL then it was very fast from the beginning I would anyway need to bump per-pair cost in pairing (increase) cause I’ve made a stupid error in my previous derivations Can you share a representative set of test cases for benchmarking? I've only barely had time to skim all this but on the "dead and never coming back, this number is officially burned and will never become used" comment I'll point out that numbers in Github cannot be reused, and that I've long objected to removing EIPs from the repo. (If what I just said is irrelevant please ignore.) All fits 👍
